optionalIntegrations.description: Adds dnd5e-specific REST endpoints and MCP tools (ability checks, saves, skills, rests, spell slots, item/activity use) on top of the generic Document API. Core endpoints work without this.

recommends.reason: Not required. When the world's game system is dnd5e, this module exposes additional dnd5e-specific REST/MCP endpoints (rolls, rests, spell slots).
